_why: NIGHT26 D-3 (GG: 'you slowly unlock weapons as you go on and maybe two levels in between the next weapon'): the weapon a level EARNS when it is cleared, one row per level in play order. The campaign starts with the KESTREL (revolver) and the PULSE (gauntlet) and owns, at any time, those two plus the `earns` of every level cleared (Core/Unlocks26.cs: OwnedAfter). Survival modes ignore this file. A level's LIMIT flags still override. NIGHT29 D-2 (GG 2026-10-09: 'you should only start with the pistol in the first map ... each level should kind of get you a new weapon'): level 1 (the tutorial / n29-foundry) and level 2 (level2 / n29-iceline) award NOTHING (they have no row: the player keeps the pistol, the fist and the PULSE gauntlet); level 3 (layer1 / n29-kiln) awards the THUNDERCLAP (the shotgun; the plan also puts its pickup in the first room), then one weapon per level: NAILGUN 4, TORCH 5, ZAPPER 6, RAIL 7, BOUNCER 8, ROCKET 9 (level 10 none). The rows are keyed by level id: the old ids (tutorial, level2, layer1, level3 ...) and the NIGHT29 plan ids (n29-...) both carry the table, so either order works. Levels 4-10 are untouched this night apart from this shift.
